warmgate_pipeline.description: Curated init-pipeline warm-gate pipeline entries: one single-generation fork_coll collective and one mpi_coll collective. Each carries an explicit, non-wildcard test_filter matching exactly one gtest case (enforced by the binary-backed --gtest_list_tests preflight). Fault-injection / GDR-flush / visibility-mismatch / plugin-lifecycle / first-init-semantics / NetIb / P2P tests are deliberately excluded.

tests.name: warmgate_fork_allreduce
tests.description: Pinned single-generation fork collective. Replace test_filter with the exact suite.case verified on your build; the preflight rejects a zero- or multi-match filter.

tests.name: warmgate_mpi_allreduce
tests.description: Plain MPI collective from ce/CeMPITests.cpp (real suite.case, verified present in the tree). Confirm it is built and passing on your configuration before relying on the gate; must NOT be a fault-injection / GDR-flush / visibility-mismatch / first-init-semantics case.

warmgate_serial.description: Host-only serial control (warmup_profile none): must receive NEITHER RCCL_TEST_WARMUP_PROFILE NOR rendezvous env, and must never be launched by the loader.

tests.name: warmgate_serial_control
tests.description: Host-only case from BitOpsTests.cpp (built into rccl-UnitTestsFixtures); kept serial by policy. Serial entries skip the gtest preflight, so a filter that matches nothing here would exit 0 having run nothing.

test_suites.name: warmgate_serial
test_suites.description: Host-only serial control (second suite -> proves one run-wide scheduler spans suites).
